title: Minimax Regret for Learning Copula-Robust Quantile-of-Treatment-Effect Policies

proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the finite-cell regular-crossing minimax rate and an adaptive signed-power upper bound, then repaired redundant assumptions and related-work prose until the math and rubric reviews passed without findings. The field-tier attempt stopped because the theorem remained restricted to prespecified cells and balanced randomization, while the exact higher-order crossing converse and branch-switching frontier were left open. A future field attempt needs a new same-class lower experiment or a substantive partition-selection result.
tldr: Cui--Han's copula-robust median-gain lottery is known at the population level, while Fan--Park's sharp endpoint estimators are known statistically. The missing object is the sampling price of learning the lottery itself. For a randomized trial with \(K\) labelled cells, unrestricted conditional potential-outcome copulas, bounded outcomes, continuous marginal CDFs, and regular linear envelope crossings, this project derives an empirical-CDF policy and proves that its expected worst-case loss gap relative to the oracle has the sharp all-procedure order \(\sum_{j=1}^{K}\omega_j\min\{1,(n\omega_j)^{-1/2}\}\). No density cap or ambiguity-width cap is imposed. Equal cell masses give \(\min\{1,\sqrt{K/n}\}\). The converse uses a fixed-support smooth perturbation of observable marginal densities whose sharp endpoints move the interior oracle probability, rather than treating endpoints as observed data. Under only a signed-power lower-crossing condition of fixed \(\gamma>1\), the same policy adaptively attains the upper bound \(\sum_j\omega_j\min\{1,(n\omega_j)^{-1/(2\gamma)}\}\); this one-sided condition neither identifies an exact order nor establishes the higher-order minimax rate.
gap: Cui--Han derive the robust randomized oracle and an asymptotic regret remainder, and Fan--Park estimate the sharp quantile-of-treatment-effect endpoints, but neither paper determines a finite-cell minimax sampling rate for excess worst-case regret over all learned randomized policies.
fill: The project combines empirical-envelope contraction and random-count control with a smooth Beta tilt and an Assouad reduction to establish the allocation-sensitive sharp rate. The result isolates the statistical cost of covariate stratification for gain-sensitive policy choice.
